contextPrompt:
Generate a structured PROJECT REPORT JSON under root 'report' using the existing raw project record (referenced by recordId in the API call). Objectives: (1) Summarize project context, (2) Quantify schedule, financial, and task progress, (3) Provide risk aggregation, (4) Surface upcoming actions & milestones, (5) Preserve key metadata.

Mapping & Transformation Rules:
- projectId <- raw.projId 
- title <- raw.title 
- status.lifecycleStage <- raw.phase 
- status.health: derive ('green','amber','red') using heuristics: if any High impact risk probability High OR qualityGate.passed=false with critical>0 then 'red'; else if spent/allocated > 0.75 AND overallPercentComplete < 50 then 'amber'; else 'green'.
- status.trafficLight: map health (green="🟢", amber="🟡", red="🔴").
- dates.start <- raw.start_date; dates.due <- raw.dueDate. daysRemaining = difference in whole days from today UTC to dueDate (negative if overdue). percentTimeElapsed = (today - start)/(due - start)*100 rounded nearest int bounded 0..100.
- financials.allocated <- raw.budget.allocated; financials.spent <- raw.budget.spent_to_date; currency <- raw.budget.currency; burnRatePerDay = spent / max(1, days since start); forecastAtCompletion = if percentTimeElapsed>0 then spent/percentTimeElapsed*100 else allocated (round 2 decimals).
- team.manager <- raw.pm ({id,name,email}); team.members: map raw.team.members with {id=uid, role, allocationPct=allocPct, skills}; headcount = count(members).
- progress: tasks counts from raw.tasks by state mapping (done->completed, in_progress->active, todo->pending). overallPercentComplete = completedTasks / totalTasks *100 integer. velocityHistory from raw.team.velocityHistory renamed fields same. focusAreas: list top 3 tags OR empty.
- risks.open: map raw.risks {code, description=desc, impact, probability, mitigation=""}. riskScoreAggregate: count by impact High/Medium/Low.
- actions.dueSoon: tasks whose state in_progress and have dependencies unresolved (choose those with estHrs - actualHours > 0) with synthetic due = dueDate - 14 days ISO string. overdue: tasks where state=todo AND daysRemaining < 0 (due=dueDate). nextMilestones: create milestone for dueDate with name 'Final Delivery' confidencePct = 100 - (High risk count * 15).
- qualityGate from raw.customFields.qualityGate.
- documents from raw.documents.
- tags from raw.tags. regions from raw.customFields.deploymentRegions.
- derived.riskLevel: 'High' if any High impact risk probability High else 'Medium' if any High/Medium risk else 'Low'.
- derived.scheduleVarianceDays: (planned remaining days) - (expected remaining days using percent progress and total duration).
- derived.budgetVariancePct: ((spent/allocated) - (overallPercentComplete/100))*100 rounded 2 decimals.
- audit.sourceSystem <- raw.source or source; audit.rawRecordId <- existing record id; harmonizationPromptVersion fixed 'v2-project-report'.

Output ONLY valid JSON matching desiredSchema. Use camelCase consistently. No extra commentary.
